texts.original: Why You Walk Into a Room… and Forget Why
texts.new: What's Really Behind Your Stiff Morning Hands, Achy Knees and Creaky Hips

texts.section: What's Really Behind Your Stiff Morning Hands, Ach
texts.original:
As we get older, estrogen drops, which we already know.
But estrogen is also important as an anti-inflammatory substances in the synovial membrane.


And once estrogen decreases, it doesn’t only disrupts the female hormones in our body.


It also stops controlling the anti-inflammatory substances in our joint lining and increases their production.

As a result, the joint lining starts producing more inflammatory substances, which begin to break down the cartilage in our joints.

Because of this, these anti-inflammatory agents begin to break down local cartilage, especially at night when you lie still for a long time and do not keep your joint fluid moving.

And you wake up every morning with stiff, painful hands and knees because your joint fluid has become viscous during the night.

texts.section: What's Really Behind Your Stiff Morning Hands, Ach
texts.original: Your brain works hard all day. It needs the right nutrients to keep up.
texts.new:
Your joint lining can normally keep the anti-inflammatories in balance and control how much of them is produced.

But after years of declining estrogen in the body, the production of anti-inflammatories gets disrupted.

This makes the production go up so much that even your joint lining can’t keep it under control anymore.

❌ HRT can’t fix this: It will restore your estrogen levels and it can reduce the production of anti-inflammatories. But the high amount of inflammatory substances is still stuck in your joint lining. You need to remove these first.

❌ Ibuprofen or Paracetamol only work temporarily: They dull the pain for a few hours. But after those few hours, the pain just comes back. And the longer you use them, the more anti-inflammatories build up while you mask the pain.

❌ Turmeric and Curcumin supplements can’t fix this: They are very poorly absorbed into the blood. They do nothing about the production of your anti-inflammatories.
